entries.90a4557591ee772c: The group's sole business (single segment), operated through a total of 161 stores, all directly managed: 146 stores of the steak and hamburger format "Bronco Billy," 14 tonkatsu-format stores, and 1 izakaya-format store. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥30,219 million. Besides the company, it is carried out by its consolidated subsidiaries Matsuyasakae Foods Co., Ltd. (manufacture and sale of seasonings, prepared foods and others) and Les Vins Co., Ltd. (operation of "Katsumasa" and others).
entries.92d3e9c62f2159b9: The main format, with 146 directly managed stores in suburban locations along arterial roads. The main steak and hamburger are mainly made with Australian and U.S. beef, processed at the company's own factory and shipped to stores daily, and served together with fresh salad (salad bar).
entries.eb55c64e25ce43b9: A format of 14 tonkatsu specialty stores, including "Katsuhiro" and "Katsumasa." The company made Les Vins Co., Ltd., which operates "Katsumasa" and others in Aichi Prefecture, a subsidiary, combining its locally rooted brand strength with the group's ingredient procurement and factory processing capabilities.
